title: Toddler Boy, Toy Wheelbarrow and Picket Fence - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait of a young toddler boy standing beside a small toy wheelbarrow in a backyard. He wears a knit skullcap or beanie, a buttoned cardigan sweater, long trousers, and shoes, with one finger thoughtfully held up to his mouth. Behind him, a sunny residential setting is visible, complete with a classic white picket fence, large leafy trees, and a house with multi-pane windows.
